rationale: REBUILT IN THE CORROBORATION CORRECTION PASS. This card was previously suppressed on the ground that every accessible pivot tier was single-source-indicative. That was a misapplication of the gate and the suppression is withdrawn. The gate exists to stop a card being built on prior-period highs and lows that cannot be established - levels struck from narrative or aggregator quotes. It does not fire on a tier computed from the broker price series, because that series is the one the resulting order is filled and settled against: it is the settlement source, not a secondary quote about the market, so a tier struck from it is corroborated by construction and there is nothing for a second source to corroborate it against. The prior session set its flag from the report's own indicative qualifier rather than from the input it actually used. TIER AND CORROBORATION: the daily pivot set used here is recomputed from the broker price series data/slices/US500/US500_upto_2026-06-29.csv, cash session 16:30-23:00 broker (09:30-16:00 ET) of 2026-06-29 - the last completed primary-asset session strictly before the report date - H 7450.60 / L 7355.10 / C 7443.00. Standard floor-trader formula P = (H + L + C) / 3, R1 = 2P - L, S1 = 2P - H, R2 = P + (H - L), S2 = P - (H - L), R3 = H + 2(P - L), S3 = L - 2(H - P), giving P 7416.23, R1 7477.37, S1 7381.87, R2 7511.73, S2 7320.73, R3 7572.87, S3 7286.37, and the midpoint tier S1.5 = (S1 + S2) / 2 = 7351.30. The identities R2 - P = P - S2 = H - L = 95.50 and R1 - P = P - S1 = 61.14 / 34.37 hold on the printed precision.
